articles.full_text:
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast an orange color warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall over Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Delhi, Haryana, Punjab, Chandigarh, Himachal Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand tomorrow. Similar weather conditions are likely to prevail over Coastal Karnataka, Madhya Maharashtra, South Interior Karnataka and Vidarbha till tomorrow.
The weather agency has predicted heavy rainfall over Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Jharkhand, Kerala, Mahe, Konkan and Goa, Madhya Pradesh, North Interior Karnataka and Telangana till 31st of this month. IMD has also forecast heavy rainfall conditions over Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Meghalaya, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura till 2nd of the next month.
The Met Department said that thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds are likely to prevail over the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Gangetic West Bengal, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal and Telangana during the next two to three days. Similar weather conditions are expected over Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh till 2nd of the next month. Meanwhile, hot and humid weather conditions are expected to prevail at isolated places over Coastal Andhra Pradesh till tomorrow.

articles.full_text:
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a red colour warning for very heavy to extremely heavy rainfall over Gujarat and Madhya Maharashtra for tomorrow. Heavy rainfall is also expected over Delhi, Haryana, Chandigarh, Uttarakhand, Bihar, Himachal Pradesh, and Jammu and Kashmir during the next two days. Similar weather conditions are expected over parts of North East India, Punjab, Konkan, Goa, Odisha, Telangana, Madhya Pradesh, and Rajasthan during the next two to three days.
The Met Department also predicted thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds over Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Jharkhand, Kerala, Mahe, Lakshadweep and Andaman and Nicobar Islands tomorrow.
For Delhi, the IMD predicted a generally cloudy sky tomorrow. According to the Weather Agency, the maximum temperature will be around 33 to 35 degrees Celsius in the National Capital while the minimum temperature will hover around 25 to 27 degrees Celsius tomorrow.
